scenes.title: The problem
scenes.text: It's late, something breaks at home, and you don't know who to trust or what it should even cost. Fiakto exists to close that gap.

scenes.title: Publish in under a minute
scenes.text: A customer describes the problem in their own words and marks the spot on a map. No technical vocabulary required, and the exact address stays hidden until someone is actually hired.

scenes.title: Gemini classifies it, live
scenes.text: This is Gemini running live in Fiakto's production app, right now. It read a real request, a clogged kitchen drain, and returned this: plumbing, normal risk, a price range of twenty-five to fifty-five thousand pesos, ninety-five percent confidence. No human wrote this. Gemini did, in seconds.

scenes.title: Matched automatically
scenes.text: Only verified professionals with the right trade, the right coverage area, and a profile photo on file ever see this request, matched the instant Gemini finishes classifying it.

scenes.title: Competing quotes, real revenue
scenes.text: Professionals compete with private quotes. Nobody sees a competitor's price, and the customer's address stays hidden until they pay. Fiakto's eight percent commission is calculated and recorded automatically the moment they accept. This is where the business actually earns money.

scenes.title: Talk inside Fiakto, not WhatsApp
scenes.text: Once matched, customer and professional coordinate inside Fiakto's own chat. Try to share a phone number or an email, and it gets redacted automatically, before it's even saved.

scenes.title: Proof of work, real testimonials
scenes.text: Closing a job requires a photo of the finished work. The customer reviews it, approves, and leaves a real star rating and comment. These are testimonials Fiakto can actually show, not simulate.

scenes.title: The promise
scenes.text: Fiakto. Todo tiene solución. Every number you just saw is live right now, on Fiakto's public impacto page. Real requests, real Gemini calls, real revenue.
